howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: Get started with your perfect boat rental in just a few simple steps
howItWorks.step1Description: Explore our curated selection of boats across multiple destinations. Filter by type, location, capacity, and price to find your perfect match.
howItWorks.step2Description: Once you've found the perfect boat, contact the owner directly via WhatsApp. Discuss details, availability, and special requirements.
howItWorks.step3Description: Finalize your booking details with the owner. Agree on dates, duration, pricing, and any additional services you might need.
howItWorks.step4Description: Meet at the designated location, receive safety instructions, and embark on your unforgettable boating adventure.
howItWorks.whyChoose1Description: All boat owners are verified to ensure quality and reliability
howItWorks.whyChoose2Description: Direct contact with owners means no hidden fees or commissions
howItWorks.whyChoose3Description: Choose from stunning destinations across Portugal and Brazil
howItWorks.whyChoose4Description: Our team is here to help you every step of the way
howItWorks.safetyDescription: Your safety is our top priority. All boats are equipped with necessary safety equipment and owners provide thorough safety briefings before departure.
